query:
SELECT week_start AS period, 'All' AS segment, SUM(revenue) AS value
FROM sales_lines
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2
summary: 2 unusual run(s) for revenue by total, period 2025-Q2: All 2025-04-28 high (peak $3,791,016 vs ~$382,963 expected); All 2025-05-26 to 2025-06-16 low (peak $11,031 vs ~$442,018 expected)
